row.notes: Constructor: base vtable 0x1457a0340 then final vtable 0x1457a03a0. Writes +0x08 allocator, +0x10 id, +0x14 arg7, +0x15 = 1, +0x18 owner, a string at +0x20 (reserved to 0x16) initialised to "f1world_generic_error", +0x48 flag, and moves the 2-pointer callback from callback_pair into +0x50/+0x58. When flag is 0 it calls 0x14079c980(owner, 7, -1.0f). The default error id string "f1world_generic_error" is the useful marker for F1 World request failures.
